PDF.js 5.6.205, legacy browser build, from the installed pdfjs-dist distribution.
Upstream: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
License: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE). The matching display and worker files are kept together.

Used only to render user-selected PDF bytes locally. Ora does not enable document scripts, XFA, PDF attachment execution, external annotation actions, or JavaScript evaluation. PDF text is inserted as text, never HTML. No PDF is included in this repository.
